# KIM3310 Systems Gallery

Purpose: free resource atlas for architecture checks, runnable demos, benchmark notes, and implementation-ready systems
Free entry point: 35 repository resource pages with live demos, architecture links, and browser-local readiness checks
Revenue boundary: contextual ads only on policy-eligible public resource pages; sensitive workflows remain ad-free
Aggregate data boundary: consented four-field event counters only; no personal, sensitive, raw, event-level, or re-identifiable data sale
Canonical URL: https://kim3310-doeon-kim-portfolio.pages.dev/
Repository: https://github.com/KIM3310/doeon-kim-portfolio
System architecture: https://github.com/KIM3310/doeon-kim-portfolio/blob/main/docs/system-architecture.md
Revenue architecture: https://github.com/KIM3310/doeon-kim-portfolio/blob/main/docs/revenue-architecture.md

Lead capture: https://kim3310-doeon-kim-portfolio.pages.dev/?offer=doeon-kim-portfolio&inquiry=architecture-scope-sprint#private-inquiry
Resource route: https://kim3310-doeon-kim-portfolio.pages.dev/resources/doeon-kim-portfolio/

Use this project as a runnable or inspectable reference for operational AI, agent reliability, incident operations, secure workflows, data contracts, industrial validation, and local-first utilities.
